risk_summary: The disclosure is moderately forward-looking and relies heavily on expectations regarding production expansion, commodity prices, cost savings, and future financing, although it includes several dollar amounts and operational milestones. Key risks include supplier dependence, commodity-price volatility, execution of Mexican facilities, reliance on restricted-stock issuance, and substantial preferred-stock liquidation preferences and undeclared dividends.
